parts.text: After consulting my railway timetable, I noted with satisfaction that there was an express train to Westhaven . with satisfaction = satisfiedly 满意地 It went direct from my local station and the journey lasted a mere hour and seventeen minutes. last v.持续 adj.最后的；最近的，上一个的 direct (未修饰其它词时) = directly adv.直接地，径直地 When I boarded the train, I could not help noticing that a great many local people got on as well . board a bus / train / ship / plane 登上公共汽车/火车/轮船/飞机(比get on 正式一些) can't help (doing) sth. ... 忍不住(做)某事. ... At the time , this did not strike me as odd . At the time, I didn't think this was odd. 基本写法 strike sb. as 给某人某种印象，某人感到，觉得… I reflected that there must be a great many people besides myself who wished to take advantage of this excellent service . reflect v.心想，考虑 take advantage of sth. 利用某物 Neither was I surprised when the train stopped at Widley, a tiny station a few miles along the line. 部分倒装 只把助动词，be动词（之前没有其他助动词）或情态动词置于主语之前。 Even a mighty express train can be held up by signals. mighty adj. very large, powerful, or impressive hold sb. / sth. ⇔ up to delay sb. or sth. 耽搁、使延误 But when the train dawdled at station after station, I began to wonder. dawdle v. to take a long time to do sth. or go somewhere 花很长时间做某事、或者去某地(缓慢地、磨蹭地做某事) sth. after sth. 一个接一个(前后零冠词) It suddenly dawned on me that this express was not roaring down the line at ninety miles an hour, but barely chugging along at thirty . sth. dawn on sb. 某人想到了某事(无灵主语“某事被某人给想到了”)、使开始明白 人做主语 想到、想起做某事 roar down 呼啸着沿...冲下来 （呼啸而下） chug v. if a car, train etc. chugs somewhere, it moves there slowly, with the engine making a repeated low sound 发出轧轧声；发出嘎嚓声；发出轧轧声前进 One hour and seventeen minutes passed and we had not even covered half the distance. cover v. travel (a certain distance) I asked a passenger if this was the Westhaven Express , but he had not even heard of it. hear of / about 听说 I determined to lodge a complaint as soon as we arrived . determine / resolve to do sth. (fml.) 决定/决心做某事; lodge / bring / file a complaint 提出申诉、投诉 Two hours later, I was talking angrily to the station master at Westhaven. stationmaster / station master an official in charge of a railroad or bus station 站长 When he denied the train's existence, I borrowed his copy of the timetable. deny + sth. / doing / that ... 否认 There was a note of triumph in my voice when I told him that it was there in black and white . note n. a way of speaking or writing that shows what someone's feelings are 语言文字中带有某种感情 in black and white in writing or in print 白纸黑字（书写的或印刷的） Glancing at it briefly, he told me to look again. glance at ... 扫视、浏览、匆匆一瞥 A tiny asterisk conducted me to a footnote at the bottom of the page. conduct sb. to ... 引导某人去… footnote n. a note at the bottom of the page in a book, which gives more information about something 脚注(额外的注释内容单个使用“*”，多个使用¹ ² ³) It said : 'This service has been suspended .' 对应文章开头 say v.上面写着⋯ suspend v.暂停，中止；使暂停使用（或生效）；使暂时停职

rows: She completed the task with ease. = She completed the task easily.她轻松地完成了任务。

She looked at her son with pride. = She looked at her son proudly.她自豪地看着她的儿子。
He greeted his old friend with a smile. = He greeted his old friend smilingly.他微笑着迎接他的老朋友。
The students listened to the lecture with attention. = The students listened to the lecture attentively.学生们专心地听讲座。

He agreed to the proposal with reluctance. = He agreed to the proposal reluctantly.他不情愿地同意了这个提议。
